mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO notification_delivery ( event_id, tenant_id, recipient_user_id, course_id, notification_type, subject_type, subject_id, event_key, channel, status, message, deep_link, template_vars_json, occurred_at, digest_date, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, unknown_outcome_count, failure_category, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{row.eventId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.recipientUserId}, #{row.courseId}, #{row.notificationType}, #{row.subjectType}, #{row.subjectId}, #{row.eventKey}, #{row.channel}, #{row.status}, #{row.message}, #{row.deepLink}, #{row.templateVarsJson}, #{row.occurredAt}, #{row.digestDate}, 0, #{row.nextAttemptAt}, 0, #{row.failureCategory}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_delivery SET status = 'FAILED_RETRYABLE', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, failure_category = #{failureCategory}, last_error = #{lastError}, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken}

UPDATE notification_delivery SET status = 'FAILED_PERMANENT', failure_category = #{failureCategory}, last_error = #{lastError}, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken}

UPDATE notification_delivery SET status = 'SKIPPED_PREFERENCE', failure_category = 'PERMANENT_PREFERENCE', claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND channel IN ('IMMEDIATE_EMAIL', 'DAILY_DIGEST') AND ( status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED_RETRYABLE') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM notification_delivery WHERE digest_email_id = #{digestEmailId} ORDER BY occurred_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_delivery WHERE digest_email_id = #{digestEmailId}
